title: Mend a broken bowl with gold, so the crack becomes the decoration
alt: A wide pale stoneware bowl with brushed white decoration and thin gold lines running across it, on a purple cushion.

posts.facebook:
Kintsugi is the Japanese art of mending ceramics with lacquer and gold. Traditional urushi lacquer is slow, cured layer by layer over weeks, while modern classes use glue and gold leaf in a day. Find a broken glazed piece that is mostly complete, and book a beginners' class.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-kintsugi/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
